name: Budget constraint objection
description: Customer receives a quote then states they only have a fixed budget to spend, testing the AI's ability to handle a budget constraint objection by offering solutions within budget

messages.text: Hi, I'm Karim. Can I get a quote for 20 sheets of white melamine chipboard 16mm?
I only have R5000 to spend

expected_behaviors.description: AI should handle the objection with empathy and offer solutions within the stated budget
AI should re-attempt a close after handling the objection
Objection handling reply should arrive within 15 seconds

forbidden_patterns.description: Tags should be stripped from customer-facing message
AI should not give up after a single objection

notes: Budget constraint objection. AI should acknowledge the budget, work within it by suggesting a smaller quantity, a different grade, or a payment plan, and re-attempt a close on what is affordable.
